messages.subject: inla program crashed
parts:
Hi team,

v_cov1b <- Vacc_any_train ~ 1 + as.factor(MnTT2)  + as.numeric(Rural) + as.numeric(Over58) +
  f(Week, model="ar1", hyper = list(theta = list(prior='pc.prec', param=c(1,0.1)))) +
  f(CID, model ="iid") 


mod.1b <- inla(v_cov1b, 
               family = "binomial", 
               data = Vaccination_cov, 
               Ntrials = Pop2, 
               control.inla=list(strategy="laplace", tolerance = 1e-20, h=1e-05),
               control.compute=list(config=TRUE, dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, mlik = TRUE, cpo=TRUE),
               control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link=1),
               quantiles =  c(0.025, 0.05,0.5,0.95, 0.975),
               control.fixed= list(expand.factor.strategy = "inla", 
                                   #mean.intercept = 1, 
                                   prec.intercept = 0.1),
               verbose=TRUE)

summary(mod.1b)

i have been trying to run the above model but it crashes everytime.
What could be the possible causes of the error?

Thanks.
